situations.headline: Albertsons appoints Meg Whitman as Executive Chair; board expands to 11, Fennebresque becomes Lead Independent Director

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Albertsons appoints Meg Whitman as Executive Chair; board expands to 11, Fennebresque becomes Lead Independent Director (interest 6, risk 3)

thesis.text: Albertsons' addition of Meg Whitman as Executive Chair, paired with governance restructuring (Fennebresque to Lead Independent Director, board expanded to 11), signals an accelerated push toward technology/AI-driven operating transformation under CEO Susan Morris [us:0001646972-26-000054 EX-99.1]. Whitman's track record turning around large-scale consumer/tech businesses (eBay, HP/HPE) and current board seats at CoreWeave and Fervo Energy suggest possible emphasis on AI infrastructure, digital retail modernization, or strategic optionality (including potential M&A or activist-style value creation) [us:0001646972-26-000054 EX-99.1]. No financial catalyst or transaction is disclosed yet, so this is a qualitative governance event; the file should be watched closely for follow-on strategic announcements (capital allocation, deal activity, AI capex) that could re-rate the stock.
